paragraphs: I'm applying for the Analyst role in the Infrastructure Investment Banking group in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Infrastructure, especially power and data centers, is the sector I want to build a career in, and the posting's description of small client teams on M&A and capital raising is the kind of exposure I'm looking for.

On modeling and valuation, I valued J.M. Smucker in my MBA coursework with comps, a DCF checked against a sell-side model, and an LBO. I also modeled a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio, covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR, and compared debt structures to recommend a phased green loan + ABS approach. Professionally, at Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I built models to evaluate $10M in marketing-channel budget deployment.

My valuation work has been in coursework rather than on live deals, so I'd be learning execution on the job. What I bring is careful modeling, clear presentation materials, and a real interest in infrastructure. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Infrastructure IB Analyst role at Guggenheim. In my MBA I built a DCF, comps and LBO for J.M. Smucker and modeled a 35.4 MW solar portfolio, and at Lenovo I built forecasts that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'd love to hear what the infrastructure group is busiest with. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
